sources.entry: Divvy - Window management at its finest with its amazing Divvy Grid system.

summary.name: Divvy
summary.one_liner: Divvy is a window management utility for Mac OS X and Microsoft Windows that resizes and positions windows by dividing the screen into portions.
use_cases: resize windows to exact screen portions
arrange windows on a grid layout
create keyboard shortcuts for window placement
reduce scattered windows on the desktop
organize workspace on mac or windows
summary.what_it_does: Divvy lets you divide your screen into exact portions using a grid interface. A single click and drag in the Divvy interface resizes and moves the active window to the chosen portion of the screen. You can also create custom shortcuts that resize and move windows to set positions. The page describes it as designed to stay out of the way while providing window management.
notable: Grid-based window layout via click and drag in the Divvy interface
Custom shortcuts to resize and move windows
Listed in awesome-mac under Window Management
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
Page is brief and marketing-style, with few technical details
